settings.title: Everything a download needs
settings.description: Files, a sales page and a plan, without a separate storefront.

items.title: Any file type
items.description: Attach any file from your media library. Files are stored privately, so only people with access can download them.

items.title: One ZIP for the buyer
items.description: A buyer selects Download files and gets one ZIP, named after the product, with every live file in it.

items.title: Draft and live files
items.description: Keep a file in draft until it is ready. Learners only get the live files.

items.title: A sales page
items.description: Each download gets a sales page on your site that you edit in the page editor.

items.title: Free or paid plans
items.description: Sell it once, or offer several plans. Paid plans use your own payment account.

items.title: Download tracking
items.description: See how many downloads you have, and whether each customer has downloaded yet.

settings.title: Turn a free download into *subscribers*
settings.body:
A **lead magnet** is a free download that people get for an email address. Choose **Lead magnet** when you create the download, or switch it on later in Settings.

When someone signs up, they:

- Join your contacts as a subscriber
- Get access to the download
- Receive an email with a link to get it

Then you can email them with [broadcasts and sequences](/email-marketing).

settings.title: Launch a download in four steps

items.title: Create the draft
items.description: Choose Digital download, then Sell it or Lead magnet.

items.title: Add your files
items.description: Name each file, save it, then attach the file from your media library.

items.title: Set a plan
items.description: Use a free plan to give it away or a paid plan to sell it.

items.title: Publish and share
items.description: Go live and share the link to your sales page.

settings.title: Be clear about the *limits*
settings.body:
Downloads are simple on purpose. The ZIP a learner gets holds up to 300 MB of files in total. A download keeps a single section, and it has no drip schedules, quizzes, certificates or discussions.

If you want lessons, take a look at [courses](/courses).

items.question: Can I sell a download and give it away at the same time?
items.answer: Not as a lead magnet. A lead magnet needs exactly one plan, and it must be free. Switch Lead magnet off if you want to add paid plans.

items.question: How big can a download be?
items.answer: The ZIP a learner receives can hold up to 300 MB of files in total. Files uploaded to your media library can be up to 1 GB each.

items.question: Do I need payments set up first?
items.answer: Only for paid plans. Free downloads and lead magnets work without a payment provider.

items.question: Can I change a download into a course later?
items.answer: No. The product type is fixed when you create it, so pick the one that fits.
